risks: The net reduction is estimated at about 720 words and is unmeasured, so the result may land slightly off target.
Losing the 'No doubt, too' sentence thins the hedged texture of the poise passage, though one 'No doubt' remains.
'He stood alone' now lacks the clergy and literary-circle context that grounded it.
summary: Removed about 720 words by estimate, mainly as whole optional sentences. The cuts fall on secondary illustration, a duplicated hedge, rhetorical connective tissue and minor biographical detail. All eight verbatim excerpts and all essential functions are kept. Only four small connection repairs were made; no material was restored or added.
